description_en: Retrieves the deployment details of an edge instance
description_zh: 获取边缘实例部署详情
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-edge-instance-deployment --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id PgEfYupSn6Pvhfkx0000 --deployment-id 9261e308a9504fde9b4cf8462b0b0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetEdgeInstanceDeployment

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The edge instance ID. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The deployment order ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135275.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: deployment_id
